svg.title: What only a drag can do needs a way that is not a drag
svg.desc: Finding 4 · by reading · a window's menu as it is, and with two rows more A discussion mockup drawn by hand from the built-in theme's colours, not a screenshot.
svg.text: What only a drag can do needs a way that is not a drag
Finding 4 · by reading · a window's menu as it is, and with two rows more
Moved and resized by dragging, and no other way
An action, a row, and a mode the arrows drive
A window's menu, and the edge it is resized by
A window: its titlebar dragged, or an edge 7 units thick
The line between tiled windows: a strip 9 units thick, dragged
Tabs put together and taken apart: the middle button, dragged
A region to take a picture of or to share: dragged
This menu opens at a right press on a titlebar, and by no key
The same menu, and a window being resized by keys
move and resize: actions, rows here, and one mode for both
The same mode for a tile's line, and a region in the picker
attach and detach for tabs, as rows and as actions
window_menu as an action, so that a key opens this menu
The keys shown are GNOME's, for the ordinary way; to be chosen
